title: AE Intake (multi-channel adverse event and complaint intake)
summary: Five roles including field reps who see only their own reports, a safety inbox fed by email and web form, cases with the four minimum criteria, a duplicate check and a 24-hour routing SLA, MedDRA-coded events, follow-ups with three attempts, QA review with a complaint investigation, E2B(R3) export with acknowledgements, and case and reporter 360 pages.
